analystSource: Deposit-type adjustments extracted verbatim from the 'Caveat / Deposit-Type Nuance' column of the analyst's quality matrix. These let the classifier pick the right tier slice for a given company (e.g. porphyry vs vein widths, Athabasca U vs ISR U).

widthAdjustment.note: Porphyries need 100m+ widths to be considered Exceptional on the width axis. A 5m intercept is narrow for a porphyry but normal for a vein.

gradeAdjustment.note: Porphyries deliver bulk-tonnage at moderate grade. Don't penalise sub-1% Cu in a porphyry the way you would in a vein system.

orogenic_gold.label: Orogenic gold
orogenic_gold.note: Workbook median 2.94 g/t gold sits at the Strong/Moderate boundary; orogenic gold systems typically run 3-8 g/t at OP cut-off.

widthAdjustment.note: Veins need <10m at high grade to be Exceptional. Wide intercepts in vein systems often signal dilution rather than continuity.

gradeAdjustment.note: Vein systems must be evaluated on grade × width rather than width alone.

open_pit.label: Open Pit mining
open_pit.cutoffNote: OP cut-off is typically lower than UG — Gold OP cut-off 0.3–1.5 g/t depending on AISC; UG cut-off 2–5 g/t.

underground.label: Underground mining
underground.cutoffNote: UG cut-off typically 2–5 g/t for gold depending on mining method and depth.

gradeAdjustment.note: Athabasca grades 10%+ U₃O₈ are exceptional globally. The U grade tiers in the matrix are anchored on this style (Denison Wheeler River, 491m @ 20% U₃O₈).
ISR sandstone-hosted U typically 0.05–0.5%. The default uranium tiers in matrix.json are Athabasca-biased and would tier ISR projects as Red Flag. Apply this scaler before classifying.
Sandstone-hosted U projects sit at 0.05–0.5%. Like ISR, apply scaling before using default U tiers.

massive_sulphide_nickel.label: Massive sulphide nickel
massive_sulphide_nickel.note: Tier breakpoints anchored on Talon Metals' Tamarack massive sulphide (7.82% Ni). Disseminated Ni projects (<0.5%) tier as Weak/Red Flag.

gradeAdjustment.note: DSO typically 60%+ Fe — well above the workbook tiers (P95 ~52%). Calibrate before scoring DSO-focused juniors.

polymetallic.label: Polymetallic (Pb/Zn/Ag-bearing)
polymetallic.note: <6 g/t silver as a CREDIT METAL in polymetallic is acceptable — only a Red Flag for primary Ag.
